name: House painting
summary: How expats hire house painters in Singapore — rental touch-ups vs full repaint, low-VOC paints for humidity, and landlord colour constraints.
body:
Painting jobs range from deposit-saving touch-ups to full-unit repaints before a lease ends. Humid weather and short drying windows matter; low-VOC formulas help when you cannot leave overnight.

## Typical jobs
- Patching and spot touch-ups before move-out
- Full room / unit repaints
- Ceiling and corridor common-area adjacent work (with approvals)
- Feature walls within landlord colour rules
- Anti-mould prep on problem walls

Confirm furniture moving and masking scope in writing.

## How to choose
Prefer crews who quote surface prep separately from paint coats. Ask about drying times before furniture returns. For rentals, photograph original colours and keep leftover tins labelled.

## Practical tip
Schedule painting early in the week, not the night before key handover. Humidity can add a day you did not budget.
